mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 68 degrees and an air quality index of 51, which is a moderate level for our area.

September is set to be a busy month for advocacy. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as both Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month to help support our neighbors facing food insecurity and mental health challenges.

There is plenty to do this weekend. We have live music occurring today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while the Verona Area Kids Triathlon and the Girls Try Hockey event take place tomorrow.
In our weekly police update, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana.
Stop by for some delicious Mint Explosion today. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so you have plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop of today's featured flavor.
